eras.title: Genesis — the namespace
eras.blurb: A new namespace, and the first arguments about what podcasting could be.

eras.title: The Sphinx era, and its end
eras.blurb: Sats reach podcasting through Sphinx, then Sphinx falls away.

eras.title: Boosts, Fountain and Helipad
eras.blurb: The first boost, the value tag formalized, and the apps that carried them.

eras.title: LIT and the music drumbeat
eras.blurb: Lightning in Toolbox, the case for a music app, and the first fee-vs-split fights.

eras.title: Wavlake and value time splits
eras.blurb: Music finds a home, cross-app comments arrive, and splits learn to move with the clock.

eras.title: lnaddress arrives, the Ball begins
eras.blurb: Lightning addresses enter the namespace and the Boostagram Ball gets its name.

eras.title: Consolidation and cracks
eras.blurb: The ecosystem matures while Alby starts to close and the seams begin to show.

eras.title: Wallet wars and stablecoins
eras.blurb: Custody arguments, Nostr in Fountain, and the case for embracing stablecoins.

eras.title: Keysend's end
eras.blurb: The image tag is formalized, keysend is deprecated and dies, lnaddress takes over.
